definition: Use guarded predictions from top-3 rp=1.10 val200 rollouts. Deduplicate predictions across rollouts by bbox IoU >= 0.50 only. Match unique prediction union to GT by bbox IoU >= 0.50 only. unlabeled = unique_union_pred - matched_gt_clusters. Optional heavy-burst filter drops a run-image contribution when guarded pred_count > max(20, 2*gt_count).
